title: Better Deck or Different Judge? Evaluating Agentic Harness Gains in Corporate and Investment Banking
abstract: arXiv:2609.39958v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Corporate and investment banking teams use presentations to support credit decisions and advise clients on financing and transactions. Producing these decks requires reconciling financial data, tracing sources and turning analysis into a recommendation. We retrospectively study the development of an agentic harness combining a 27B language model, financial calculations, narrative templates and validation checks. LLM judges guide engineering changes and assess the resulting decks, raising the question of whether higher scores reflect better documents or changes in grading. In shared-session text-only grading with template markers removed, five judges score the complete system 20.4 to 33.6 points out of 95 above the same model generating directly from a short prompt. Every judge scores the system higher on all seventeen development deliverables. Margins against direct Opus generation from a short prompt range from -4.7 to +0.8 points. Judg

translated_title: 更好的演示文稿还是不同的评委？评估企业与投资银行业务中智能体框架的增益
translated_abstract: 企业和投资银行团队使用演示文稿来支持信贷决策，并就融资和交易向客户提供咨询建议。制作这些演示文稿需要整合财务数据、追溯数据来源，并将分析转化为建议。我们回顾性地研究了一个智能体框架的开发过程，该框架结合了27B语言模型、金融计算、叙事模板和验证检查。LLM评委指导工程改进并评估最终生成的演示文稿，这引出了一个疑问：更高的分数究竟是反映了文档质量的提升，还是源于评分标准的变化。在去除模板标记的共享会话纯文本评分中，五位评委对完整系统的评分（满分95分）比同一模型直接从简短提示词生成的内容高出20.4至33.6分。每位评委对所有十七个开发交付物都给出了系统更高的评分。与Opus直接从简短提示词生成相比，分差范围在-4.7至+0.8分之间。
tldr: 本研究开发了一个结合27B语言模型、金融计算与验证检查的智能体框架，用于企业与投资银行业务演示文稿的自动化制作，并通过多位LLM评委的严格评估证明其相比直接生成方法可提升20.4至33.6分（满分95分）。
en_tdlr: This study develops an agentic harness combining a 27B language model, financial calculations, and validation checks for automated corporate and investment banking presentation creation, demonstrating through rigorous multi-judge evaluation significant score improvements of 20.4 to 33.6 points (out of 95) over direct generation.
